categories.name: Contemporary Art
categories.description: Definitive paintings, installations, and mixed-media works created by leading living practitioners.

categories.name: Abstract Art
categories.description: Chromatic fields, architectural minimalism, and expressive non-figurative compositions.

categories.name: Modern Art
categories.description: Masterworks influenced by 20th-century avant-garde movements and formal abstraction.

categories.name: Photography
categories.description: Archival silver gelatin prints, platinum-palladium editions, and large-format fine art photography.

categories.name: Sculpture
categories.description: Lost-wax cast bronzes, carved Carrara marble, and architectural steel forms.

categories.name: Paintings
categories.description: Oil on Belgian linen, encaustic, and pigment works of museum provenance.

categories.name: Works on Paper
categories.description: Intimate charcoal studies, gouache, ink drawings, and unique monotypes on archival rag paper.

categories.name: Emerging Artists
categories.description: Curated discoveries from rising studio talent selected by the ArtAlly Curatorial Board.

categories.name: Limited Editions
categories.description: Numbered, artist-signed editions and foundry-stamped sculptural multiples.

categories.name: Mixed Media
categories.description: Interdisciplinary works combining gold leaf, raw textiles, mineral pigments, and found matter.
